messages:
Jess Carter: quick accessibility pass on the Command Palette (Cmd+K) + Help menu. VoiceOver reads the palette as 'dialog' but then nothing else for a second, users hear silence. Can repro.
Arun Venkataraman: steps? Which macOS/safari?
Jess Carter: macOS Sonoma + Safari and Chrome. Steps: open palette -> type 'export' -> suggestions appear visually but VO doesn't announce them until you press down arrow.
Ella Ruiz: that sounds like the listbox isn't properly announced. Are the suggestion items role=\"option\" or role=\"menuitem\"? listbox/option works well with aria-activedescendant pattern.
Rajiv Shah: I pulled the markup: container role=\"dialog\"; suggestion list is a ul with li but no roles, each suggestion is a button. We probably need role=\"listbox\" + role=\"option\" or role=\"menu\" + role=\"menuitem\" consistently.
a11y-bot: auto-check: command-palette list missing aria-live for results, aria-activedescendant not implemented, focus not set to internal search input on open in some cases, contrast for placeholder text <3:1 on dark theme.
Jess Carter: placeholder contrast is separate. For announcements: suggestion lists should either be in an aria-live region that updates as results change, or use active descendant so screen reader announces active item when arrowing. But avoid double announcements.
Arun Venkataraman: my preference: keep input in the dialog and set focus to it on open (tabindex=-1 on container not needed). Use role=\"listbox\" on results and role=\"option\" on items and implement aria-activedescendant on the input. That way VO announces the active option as you navigate.
Ella Ruiz: agree. Also ensure that when results update (typing), we announce a count like '5 results, use up and down arrow to navigate' using an aria-live polite region that only announces when the number changes, not on every keystroke. Debounce to 300ms.
Rajiv Shah: snippet idea:
```
// palette-accessibility.js
inputEl.focus()
inputEl.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', activeOptionId)
resultsEl.setAttribute('role','listbox')
itemEl.setAttribute('role','option')
liveCountEl.setAttribute('aria-live','polite')
```

Jess Carter: small nuance: aria-activedescendant requires that the active option is focusable via script only (no tabindex on items). Use tabindex=-1 on items and control active id on input. Also test VoiceOver rotor behaviour.
Arun Venkataraman: also ensure that keyboard shortcut handling doesn't swallow focus. We currently listen global keydown for Cmd+K and call event.preventDefault but then open palette after a small async. That can leave focus in body causing VO delay. Open palette synchronously and focus input immediately.
Ella Ruiz: tooltip vs aria-label: help menu icons have tooltips but some icons are svg with title tag only. Title is not reliable for AT. Use aria-label on the button and keep svg title for sighted tooltip.
a11y-bot: note: using title alone fails NVDA in some setups. Recommend aria-label or sr-only text.
Rajiv Shah: Help menu also supports keyboard navigation but lacks aria-haspopup and aria-expanded attributes on the trigger. Add aria-haspopup=\"menu\" and aria-expanded toggles. Also ensure the menu has role=\"menu\" and items role=\"menuitemradio\" for toggles.
Jess Carter: good point about menuitemradio for view mode toggles. And add aria-checked for toggle states.
Arun Venkataraman: for SR copy: prefer explicit instructions like 'Press Slash to focus search' rather than just listing shortcuts. Add an sr-only hint inside the palette header that reads keyboard shortcuts available. Keep that hint collapsed visually but accessible.
Ella Ruiz: automated tests: Storybook story with a11y tabbing demo and VoiceOver checklist; axe will catch role issues, but include an integration test: cypress opens palette, types 'exp', asserts live count announces '3 results' and that pressing ArrowDown sets aria-activedescendant to first option id.
Rajiv Shah: also add unit test to ensure input.focus called synchronously when shortcut triggers. That will prevent accidental timing regressions.
Jess Carter: one last mobile note: on iOS Safari the keyboard covers the palette and sometimes the first result is offscreen. Use scrollIntoView on active item when arrowing and call focus with preventScroll true on input to avoid jumping.
a11y-bot: checklist: set focus on input on open, use role=listbox/option + aria-activedescendant, debounce live-count annoucements, add aria-labels to icon buttons, add aria-haspopup/aria-expanded to help trigger, include SR-only shortcut hint, add scrollIntoView for active item, add cypress/storybook tests.
Arun Venkataraman: I'll open a small PR with the aria-activedescendant implementation + live count debounce. Will attach test plan.
Ella Ruiz: I'll follow up with a demo in Storybook so QA can run VoiceOver.
Jess Carter: thanks both. Assigning to @Arun for the patch. Please ping when draft is ready so I can run an AT pass. :mag:
